nameOrigin: creature with pincers and a stinger in its tail

pokedexEntries.di: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

pokedexEntries.prl: Its body is encased in a sturdy shell. Its head rotates 180 degrees, eliminating blind spots.

pokedexEntries.pt: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

pokedexEntries.bw: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

pokedexEntries.sw: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

pokedexEntries.sh: It’s so vicious that it’s called the Sand Demon. Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapion keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.

pokedexEntries.la: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.
